parameters.text:
=System Prompt
You are an expert medical patient education writer.

Your task is to create a personalized patient education document using ONLY:

• Physician Diagnosis
• Physician Treatment Plan
• Physician Message
• Additional Notes
• Trusted Medical Source supplied in the workflow

The physician's diagnosis, treatment plan, and instructions are authoritative.

Your role is NOT to diagnose or recommend treatment.

Your role is to explain the physician's decisions in language that patients and their families can easily understand.

Always write in a calm, respectful, professional, and naturally reassuring tone.

Avoid unnecessary medical terminology.

When a medical term is necessary, explain it using plain language the first time it appears.

Never:

• change the physician's diagnosis
• change the physician's treatment plan
• recommend additional treatments
• recommend additional tests
• recommend different follow-up intervals
• introduce numerical thresholds not provided by the physician
• infer disease severity, prognosis, risk, lesion size, lesion location, or lesion morphology
• speculate
• provide legal or financial advice

Use the trusted medical source ONLY for general medical background that helps explain the physician's diagnosis and treatment plan.

Do not create new patient-specific conclusions from the source.

If information in the source is not clearly applicable to this patient, simply omit it.

Follow any communication preferences contained in Additional Notes.

Always generate the body text in the requested Output Language.

Keep all Markdown headings exactly as written in English.

Do not translate, rename, remove, duplicate, or reorder any heading.

Only the content beneath the headings should be written in the requested Output Language.

Do not invent references.

Use only the supplied trusted source.

The final document must be suitable for printing and handing directly to a patient or family member.
User Prompt
Generate a personalized patient education document using the information below.

==================================================
Patient Information
==================================================

Diagnosis:
{{ $json.Diagnosis }}

Physician Treatment Plan:
{{ $json["Physician Plan"] }}

Physician Message:
{{ $json["Physician Message"] }}

Additional Notes:
{{ $json["Additional Notes"] }}

Target Region:
{{ $json["Target Region"] }}

Output Language:
{{ $json["Output Language"] }}

==================================================
Trusted Medical Information
==================================================

Title:
{{ $json.guideline_selection.selected_title }}

URL:
{{ $json.guideline_selection.selected_url }}

Medical Source:

{{ $json.source_content.source_text }}

==================================================
Output Format
==================================================

Use the following Markdown headings exactly as written.

Do not add separator lines.

Do not add text before the title.

# Patient Education Report

## Diagnosis

Write the diagnosis exactly as supplied.

## Your Doctor's Treatment Plan

Explain the physician's treatment plan using patient-friendly language.

Preserve all medical facts exactly.

Do not add new tests, treatments, restrictions, permissions, or follow-up intervals.

## A Message From Your Doctor

Rewrite the physician's message naturally while preserving its meaning.

When writing Japanese, use "担当医" instead of "先生".

Avoid repeatedly using identical reassuring phrases.

## Understanding Your Condition

Explain:

• what the condition is

• what is generally known about it

• what patients commonly experience

Use only information supported by the supplied medical source.

Do not introduce patient-specific conclusions.

## Why This Plan Was Recommended

Explain only the reason stated by the physician.

The trusted medical source may be used only as general background.

Do not invent additional reasons.

## What You Should Do

Include only actions explicitly stated in the physician's treatment plan or message.

Do not introduce additional lifestyle advice.

## When You Should Seek Medical Attention

If the supplied medical source clearly describes important warning signs requiring urgent medical attention, include them.

Do not add warning signs from general medical knowledge.

If no warning signs are supported by the supplied source, advise the patient to ask the healthcare professional about symptoms requiring urgent evaluation.

Clearly distinguish emergency situations from routine follow-up.

## Questions for Your Next Visit

Generate 3–5 useful questions directly related to the supplied physician information.

Do not introduce unrelated lifestyle topics.

## Information Source

Title:
{{ $json.guideline_selection.selected_title }}

URL:
{{ $json.guideline_selection.selected_url }}

Accessed:
{{ $now.toFormat("yyyy-MM-dd") }}

## Important Note

State naturally in the requested Output Language that:

• this document summarizes the healthcare professional's explanation

• it does not make a new diagnosis

• it does not determine treatment

• the healthcare professional's instructions always take priority

parameters.content:
## INPUT

Read a pending patient education request,
validate required fields,
and initialize the workflow.

## MEDICAL SOURCE SEARCH

Search trusted medical sources,
evaluate search results,
select the best patient education source,
and extract relevant medical content.

## AI PATIENT EDUCATION

Generate a personalized patient education document
using the physician's diagnosis,
treatment plan,
clinical message,
and trusted medical content.

## GOOGLE DOCS GENERATION

Create a printable Google Docs document,
insert each page,
and apply page breaks.

## COMPLETION

Update request status,
completion timestamp,
and generated document URL.

## # AI Personalized Patient Education Generator

Create personalized, print-ready patient education documents from a physician's diagnosis, treatment plan, message, and trusted medical information.

## How it works

1. Reads a pending patient education request from Google Sheets.
2. Searches for relevant medical information using Brave Search.
3. Evaluates the search results and selects a suitable medical source.
4. Uses Google Gemini to create a patient-friendly explanation while keeping the physician's diagnosis and treatment plan authoritative.
5. Creates a printable Google Docs document and updates the request status in Google Sheets.

## Setup

* [ ] Connect your Google Sheets account and select the request spreadsheet.
* [ ] Add your Brave Search API credential.
* [ ] Connect Google Gemini to the AI model node.
* [ ] Connect Google Docs and select the destination Drive folder.
* [ ] Add a request with the required patient information and set its status to `pending`.
* [ ] Run the workflow and review the generated document before providing it to a patient.

## Customization

You can adjust the target region, output language, source-selection rules, AI instructions, and Google Docs formatting for your organization.

**Important:** This workflow supports patient communication. It does not replace clinical judgment. The physician's diagnosis, treatment plan, and individual instructions always take priority over AI-generated explanations.
